services.name: Microblading
services.story: The main story: $550 microblading on a guest day at Aster Salon. A $100 deposit now, and Rosie texts the $450 bill after.

services_shape: set services with a chosen artist; a first session includes one touch-up 6 to 8 weeks later
questions_before_times: is it for you, and are you 18 or older (asked first)
which area: brows, lips or eyeliner
new or returning, and any permanent makeup on that area before
for a touch-up: the date of the first session, so it falls 6 to 8 weeks after
safety_stop: a reaction happening now: face, lips or throat swelling, or trouble breathing
signs of infection after a session: spreading redness, pus or a fever
first_steps: Consult and patch test (a small dab of the pigment on the skin, watched 48 hours for a reaction)
Consent form, with aftercare advice and a note that a new tattoo can delay giving blood
license: always: permanent makeup is tattooing on the face, licensed where the state's rules require it (a tattoo, body art or permanent cosmetics license, as the state names it)
staff_skills: microblading, powder and combo brows, lip blush, eyeliner; only Hannah does lips and eyeliner at the studio
messages_never: health answers, test-spot reports, face photos and healing questions never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the client's record
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
